_comment: Crypto and metals shown below the heatmap. Prices and six-month history come
from Yahoo via yfinance, which is unmetered - Alpha Vantage could not carry
these alongside the regime engine's own symbols.
Futures contracts (the =F symbols) are front-month, which is what 'the price of
copper' means in practice. Copper is quoted per pound and aluminium per tonne,
so the units differ by metal and are labelled per row.
